blocks.title: Custom Hospitality Software Development Company in India
blocks.content: DigIT-Hack builds powerful hospitality software solutions for restaurants, cafes, salons, spas, hotels, and cloud kitchens across India. We design fast, reliable, and easy-to-use software so your team can focus on delivering great customer experiences while we handle the technology.

blocks.title: Core Features That Improve Customer Experience
items: Fast GST billing and POS system

blocks.title: Why Hospitality Businesses Choose DigIT-Hack
blocks.content: We understand the fast-paced hospitality environment. Our software is built to be quick, simple, and reliable even during peak hours. Whether you run a single restaurant or a chain of salons, our solutions scale with your business. With real-time reporting, cloud access, and dedicated support, you get complete control over operations and revenue.

blocks.title: Secure, Cloud-Based & Scalable
blocks.content: Our hospitality software is cloud-based with automatic backups and secure data storage. Access your reports from anywhere, manage multiple outlets, and scale without worrying about system limitations. We ensure fast performance, even during busy hours.

blocks.title: Custom vs Generic Software
blocks.content: Generic POS systems limit your workflow. Our custom hospitality software adapts to your business. Get only the features you need, integrate with your existing systems, and scale without restrictions. No unnecessary complexity — just software that works for you.

blocks.title: Ready to Grow Your Hospitality Business?

FAQs.question: How much does hospitality management software cost?
FAQs.answer: Pricing depends on features and number of outlets. Small businesses start from ₹25,000 one-time or ₹2,000/month. Multi-branch systems cost more based on customization.

FAQs.question: Does it support GST billing?
FAQs.answer: Yes. Our software is fully GST compliant with reports and invoice formats.

FAQs.question: Can I manage multiple outlets?
FAQs.answer: Yes. You can manage multiple branches from a single dashboard.

FAQs.question: Does it work offline?
FAQs.answer: Yes. Billing works offline and syncs automatically when internet returns.

FAQs.question: Do you provide training?
FAQs.answer: Yes. We provide full staff training and ongoing support.
